# Claw, phase 3 (splat fit, run after p2): the splat gate's model. Discs reach about a radius past a
# face, so the 0.08 m chrome bars and the cable bake fatter than drawn: pull every bar's faces in along
# their normals (a box corner moves 0.03 m, each face about 0.017 m). Only shrinks; the form (p2) is
# the mesh gate's. Generated by make_claw.py.
active ProngB
mode edit
select all
shrink-fatten -0.03
mode object
active ProngL
mode edit
select all
shrink-fatten -0.03
mode object
active ProngR
mode edit
select all
shrink-fatten -0.03
mode object
active Cable
mode edit
select all
shrink-fatten -0.012
mode object
export claw.glb
